A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HC-SMoE study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and supplied appendices are readable, and retained material can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original Qwen and Mixtral evaluations, ablations, medical question-answering results, and computational measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds Mixtral-Instruct evaluations and compression runtime/memory measurements.

M1.justification: Expert-output representations, Euclidean average-linkage clustering, frequency-weighted parameter merging, and router preservation remain unchanged. New Algorithm 1 documents the existing procedure; fixed-dominant merging and the soft-clustering adaptation already appeared in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same eight language benchmarks, MedMCQA, and C4/MATH/CodeQA calibration data. The added Mixtral-Instruct evaluation changes the model configuration while retaining the existing tasks and datasets.

E2.justification: Removing v2 Table 21 drops the Qwen 45x2.7B accuracy comparison against fixed- and random-initialized K-means, while the Qwen 30x2.7B comparison remains. New runtime/memory comparisons use the existing F-prune, S-prune, O-prune, and M-SMoE baseline set.

E3.justification: v3 adds the Mixtral8x7B-Instruct configuration and compression-cost profiling on eight V100 GPUs for Mixtral and four for Qwen. Table 22 limits Qwen O-prune profiling to 100 iterations per layer; this is a new profiling protocol, not an established revision of the main accuracy experiments.

E4.justification: v2 Table 21's unique Qwen 45-expert initialization/similarity sensitivity results are removed, although Qwen 30-expert comparisons and cluster-quality measurements remain. Appendix C adds algorithm-level runtime/memory analysis; the other calibration, linkage, merging, and extreme-compression analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Identical uncertainty values for inference throughput and latency are retained in v2 Table 19 and v3 Table 20. v3 adds no repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or statistical testing procedures.

E6.justification: Main Tables 2–3 are unchanged. Table 5 revises HC's four-task average from 0.4993 to 0.4988. v3 adds Mixtral-Instruct averages of 0.6972, 0.6806, and 0.6266 at 0%, 25%, and 50% reduction, plus runtime/memory results, while removing unique Qwen 45-expert K-means scores. These additions do not establish same-setting performance gains.

T1.justification: New Appendix A defines averaged-expert outputs, derives a Jensen approximation-error bound, presents a partition-count formula and NP-hardness claim, and asserts a cited 3×OPT approximation guarantee. This substantially expands v2's method equations and qualitative clustering rationale.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about retraining-free, task-agnostic, scalable merging and superior performance. The claim of theoretically guaranteed expert groupings already appeared in v2.

C2.justification: Appendix C newly interprets compression-algorithm measurements as demonstrating competitive runtime and memory efficiency; v2 discussed post-merging inference costs there. Existing interpretations of calibration robustness, router preservation, and soft-clustering failures remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 replaces the anonymous code-access reference with a named HC-SMoE repository in the abstract, adds explicit pseudocode and frequency normalization, and documents hardware and the O-prune iteration limit for new cost benchmarks. These improve documentation without establishing a changed method.

R1.justification: v3 adds Moseley and Wang (2023) to support the claimed average-linkage approximation guarantee. The remaining cited works and positioning against expert pruning, M-SMoE, ZipIt, and K-means are retained.

P1.justification: Most prose and section ordering remain stable. Changes include paragraph restructuring, replacing Appendix A's reproducibility note with theory and algorithm subsections, and adding an Impact Statement, acknowledgements, and updated affiliation/publication text.

P2.justification: Figures 2 and 4 are redrawn, with Figure 4 expanded into a detailed four-stage workflow and relocated to the late appendix. v3 adds Algorithm 1 and three tables, removes old Table 21, changes Table 5's highlighting, and reorganizes appendix displays. The frequency plots retain their original content.

improvement.justification: Algorithm 1, clearer diagrams, and new model/cost results improve documentation and empirical support. However, v2's unique Qwen 45-expert K-means table disappears while its 12.96% sensitivity claim remains. New Appendix A also leaves the connection between its averaged-output bound and actual frequency-weighted parameter merging unestablished. These gains and evidential limitations prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
